description: Pushes the steps of an incoming phasor early or late by a random amount, drawing a fresh set of nudges each cycle

params.text: How many steps the phasor cycle is cut into, 2 to 64, at 2 by default
Scales the STEPS CV before it is added to the knob, -1 to +1; at full depth 5V spans the whole 64-step range
How far the step timing is pushed around: exact timing fully counter-clockwise, the full amount fully clockwise
Scales the HUMANIZE CV before it is added to the knob, -1 to +1

inputs.text: The phasor to be nudged; each wrap back to the start draws a new set of timings
Modulates the step count, scaled by the attenuverter and added to the knob
Modulates the humanize amount, scaled by the attenuverter and added to the knob

notes: a phasor drives this, not a clock: a ramp rising from 0V to 10V once per cycle, from Phasor Generator, Clock to Phasor or an LFO's saw output. Nothing moves here until one is patched in.
